name: Saikin Koi Shiteru?
source:
The 17 year old nameable heroine transfers to Seiran Academy and falls into a deep pool that’s just sitting right at the entrance, and meets some…mitochondria? 
It turns out that everyone she meets has them but only she can see them. She names them Saikin (bacteria) and uses them to manipulate other peoples feelings (with…good intentions).
translation:
十七岁、可自定义姓名的女主角转入青岚学园，却掉进了入口处一个莫名其妙的深水池，并遇见了一些…线粒体？
原来，她遇见的每个人都拥有它们，只是只有她能够看见。她把这些存在命名为"细菌"，并利用它们操控他人的感情——当然，是出于…善意。
